cases.title: Select Sedan Car Type
cases.description: Verify that clicking the 'Choose Sedan' button updates the 'Car Type' field to 'Sedan' and clears the 'Total Price' field regardless of previous selections.

cases.title: Select SUV Car Type
cases.description: Verify that clicking the 'Choose SUV' button updates the 'Car Type' field to 'SUV' and clears the 'Total Price' field regardless of previous selections.

cases.title: Select Convertible Car Type
cases.description: Verify that clicking the 'Choose Convertible' button updates the 'Car Type' field to 'Convertible' and clears the 'Total Price' field regardless of previous selections.

cases.title: Calculate Total Rental Price
cases.description: Verify that entering valid rental days and clicking 'Calculate Total' computes the correct total price based on the selected car model's daily rate, and that invalid inputs or missing car selections trigger an appropriate alert.

cases.title: Form Submission with Validation
cases.description: Verify that submitting the booking form via the 'Book Now' button succeeds with a confirmation alert only when both a car is selected and the total price is calculated, and prevents submission with an error alert otherwise.

cases.title: Complete Car Rental Workflow
cases.description: Verify the end-to-end rental process including car selection, setting rental duration (minimum 1 day), calculating the total price, and successfully booking with the correct confirmation message.

opinions.feedback: All cases accurately test the specified requirements and are fully actionable and testable.

analysis.analysis: R-1: Testable behavior: Clicking 'choose-sedan-button' updates 'car-type' to 'Sedan' and clears 'total-price'. Boundaries: Works from any prior car selection. Normal path: Click button -> field updates, price clears. Abnormal path: None. Ambiguities: None. R-2: Testable behavior: Clicking 'choose-suv-button' updates 'car-type' to 'SUV' and clears 'total-price'. Boundaries: Independent of prior selections. Normal path: Click button -> field updates, price clears. Abnormal path: None. Ambiguities: None. R-3: Testable behavior: Clicking 'choose-convertible-button' updates 'car-type' to 'Convertible' and clears 'total-price'. Boundaries: Independent of prior selections. Normal path: Click button -> field updates, price clears. Abnormal path: None. Ambiguities: None. R-4: Testable behavior: Calculate total price using days and car rate. Boundaries: Minimum 1 day, maximum integer values. Normal path: Select car, enter valid days (>=1), click 'calculate-total-button' -> total calculated and shown. Abnormal path: No car selected or invalid days (zero/empty) -> alert displayed. Ambiguities: Exact error message text is not strictly defined beyond prompting selection and valid days. R-6: Testable behavior: Form submission via 'book-now-button' on 'rental-form'. Boundaries: Requires car selection and calculated price. Normal path: Car selected + price calculated + click 'book-now-button' -> success alert 'Your [Car Type] rental has been booked!'. Abnormal path: Missing car or uncalculated price -> prevents submission and shows alert 'Please select a car and calculate the total price before booking.'. Ambiguities: None. R-7: Testable behavior: End-to-end rental workflow structure. Boundaries: Min 1 rental day, readonly fields for car-type and total-price. Normal path: Select car -> enter days -> calculate total -> book now with success alert. Abnormal path: Unmet conditions block booking with error alert. Ambiguities: None.
